杨易签押制裁令，泰山拜禅（杨易签押制裁令，泰山拜禅（第22页）石矶面容庄重，目光沉静如山，望着那一条从山脚蜿蜒至玉皇顶的青石御道，几乎肉眼可见那气运凝聚而成的龙脉，忍不住微微震惊。人皇帝辛一身玄色帝袍，在黄罗伞盖的簇拥之下走上了玉皇顶，他的步伐沉稳而庄重，每一步落下都仿佛与泰山的地脉共振，帝袍之上的日月星辰刺绣在日光之下流转生辉。在帝辛身后，文武百官列成长龙，衣冠济济，步履整齐。御道左侧，武将以闻仲与黄飞虎为首。闻仲今日一身朝服，黄飞虎站在他身侧，腰悬宝剑，面容沉毅，眉宇之间带着一股沙场老将特有的从容与笃定。两人之后，大商十大雄关的总兵一字排开。汜水关总兵韩荣，面如重枣，虎背熊腰，界牌关总兵黄滚与徐盖并肩而立，一老一少气质互补。穿云关总兵陈梧与徐芳分立两侧，目光如电，临潼关总兵张凤与欧阳淳，一人持锏一人仗剑，气势凛然。潼关总兵陈桐与余化龙，一个阴沉如水，一个刚烈如火。青龙关总兵张桂芳与丘引，张桂芳依旧是那副虎头虎脑的模样，丘引则面色青白透着几分阴寒之气。佳梦关总兵胡氏昆仲，兄弟四人相貌相似气机相连，游魂关总兵窦荣，面容冷峻如铁。三山关总兵邓九公，须发花白却腰背挺直，目光精亮，陈塘关总兵张山，面色平静如水，不显山不露水。十大总兵身后，是数百员偏将校尉，甲胄鲜明，杀气凛然。御道右侧，文臣阵列丝毫不逊武官。商容居于首位，老丞相今日换了一身崭新的紫色官袍，白发梳理得一丝不苟，虽然年迈却精神矍铄。他身后是杜元铣、箕子、微子启、比干四人，个个衣冠整肃，手持玉笏，面容郑重。比干今日罕见地没有嬉笑玩闹，而是安安静静地站在文官前列。文官之后，是太学院的数百儒门学子，皆穿青色儒衫，腰佩竹简，整整齐齐地列成方阵，清风过处，衣袂翻飞如青云涌动。在泰山神殿之上，杨戬手持三尖两刃刀，身披大叶黄金锁子甲，如今早已经褪去了那少年稚嫩之气，看上去稳重如山。在杨戬身后，立着瘟神吕岳与灶王罗宣，一青一赤两道身影气机沉凝，再往后是梅山七兄弟。杨戬身边，还跟着一个人，正是哪吒的母亲殷夫人。殷夫人眼眶微微一红，她已经得知哪吒身死岐山的消息，不过杨戬却告诉了她，父亲杨易已设法搭救。虽是如此，殷夫人也难掩那眼神之中悲哀之色。父杀子嗣，这是殷夫人难以承受之重。她也想不明白，为何李靖会如此狠心。杨易最为清闲，这个时候搬着一把椅子坐在了泰山神殿的阴凉处，他身边站着两个女子，左边鬼芈一身墨色轻衣，右边邓婵玉则身披银甲，腰悬长剑，英姿飒爽。但是只有修道之人才能看的明白，杨易自身的气机，正在这个时候与九州天地，无量时空产生了共鸣。一股惶惶大运，连通天地水三界，撼动九天十地。

Yang Yi signed the sanction order and worshiped in Mount Tai (Yang Yi signed the sanction order and worshiped in Mount Tai (page 22)) Shi Ji had a solemn face and his eyes were as calm as the mountain. He looked at the bluestone royal road winding from the foot of the mountain to the top of the Jade Emperor, and almost felt The naked eye could see the dragon veins formed by the condensation of luck, and he couldn't help but be slightly shocked. The human emperor Xin, dressed in a black imperial robe, walked up to the Jade Emperor's Summit surrounded by yellow umbrellas. His steps were steady and solemn, and every step fell. As if resonating with the earth's veins of Mount Tai, the embroidery of the sun, moon and stars on the emperor's robe shines brightly in the sunlight. Behind Emperor Xin, the civil and military officials lined up in a long line, with their uniforms and uniforms walking neatly, and on the left side of the royal road, General Wen Zhong. Headed by Huang Feihu, Wen Zhong was dressed in court clothes today, and Huang Feihu stood beside him, with a sword hanging on his waist, a serious expression on his face, and a look of calmness and determination unique to a battlefield veteran. The generals are lined up. Han Rong, the general of Sishui Pass, has a face like a jujube and a strong back. Huang Gun, the general of Jiepai Pass, and Xu Gai stand side by side. Chen Wu and Xu Fang, the generals of Chuanyunguan, stand side by side with complementary temperaments. The generals of Lintong Pass, Zhang Feng and Ouyang Chun, one holding a mace and the other holding a sword, looked majestic. The generals of Tongguan, Chen Tong and Yu Hualong, were as gloomy as water, while the other was as fierce as fire. Fang still looks like a tiger with a tiger's head, while Qiu Yin's face is pale and cold, with a cold air. The four brothers have similar looks, and Dou Rong, the commander of Youhun Pass, has a face as cold as iron. Deng Jiugong, the commander-in-chief of Sanshanguan, has a gray beard but a straight back and bright eyes. Zhang Shan, the commander-in-chief of Chentangguan, has a face as calm as water, showing no signs of dew. Behind the ten generals, there are hundreds of generals and lieutenants with bright armor. On the right side of the royal road, the array of civil servants was no less impressive than that of the military attachés. The old prime minister was wearing a brand new purple official robe today, and his white hair was meticulously combed. Although he was old, he was in good spirits. Then came Du Yuanxian, Jizi, Wei Ziqi, and Bigan, all of whom were neatly dressed, holding jade tablets, and with solemn faces. Bigan, who was rare today, did not laugh or play, but stood quietly behind the civil officials. , are hundreds of Confucian students from Taiyuan University, all wearing blue Confucian shirts and wearing bamboo slips on their waists, neatly arranged in a square formation. When the breeze passes by, their clothes are flying like blue clouds. Above the Taishan Temple, Yang Jian is holding a three-pointed two-edged sword. , wearing a big-leaf golden chainmail, has long lost his youthful aura, and looks as steady as a mountain. Behind Yang Jian, stand the God of Plague Lu Yue and the Stove King Luo Xuan, one green and one red, two figures with calm energy, and then they move forward. Next came the seven Meishan brothers. Next to Yang Jian was Nezha's mother, Mrs. Yin. Mrs. Yin's eyes were slightly red. She had already learned that Nezha had died in Qishan, but Yang Jian told her that her father had died. Even so, Mrs. Yin could not hide the sadness in her eyes. It was an unbearable burden for Mrs. Yin that Li Jing was so cruel. In order to have some leisure time, he moved a chair and sat in the shade of Mount Tai Temple. There were two women standing beside him. Gui Mi on the left was dressed in dark and light clothes, and Deng Chanyu on the right was wearing silver armor with a long sword hanging from her waist. She looked heroic. . But only those who practice Taoism can understand that Yang Yi's own Qi resonates with Jiuzhou, heaven and earth, and infinite time and space, connecting the three realms of heaven, earth, and water, shaking the nine heavens and ten earths.
